purpose: Bind exact public diagnostic cases to the source probe plan so later confirmation excludes only those opened cases.

case_schema.context_token_ids: exact known public context token IDs, including BOS
case_schema.endpoint_token_ids: exact public token IDs supplied at the endpoint
case_schema.sequence_token_ids: exact concatenation of context_token_ids and endpoint_token_ids
case_schema.artifact_sha256: optional lowercase SHA-256 of that artifact

exclusion_rule.future_confirmation: exclude only exact listed case/context/endpoint tuples and sequences
